story_summary: A charismatic street hero and his fiery partner engage in a high-energy dance-off on the vibrant streets of Chennai. Their playful taunts and one-upmanship escalate into a chaotic, synchronized celebration of their explosive chemistry. The city itself becomes their dance floor in a vibrant explosion of color and motion.

characters.name: Maari
characters.visual_design: A charismatic young man with a roguish grin, wearing a simple black shirt, a black veshti (dhoti) with a patterned border, and stylish sunglasses.

characters.name: Anandhi
characters.visual_design: A spirited young woman with long, flowing dark hair and expressive eyes, wearing a vibrant festive half-sari in crimson red (#D72631) and comic yellow (#FFD60A).

story_beats.title: The Challenge
story_beats.description: On a bustling Chennai street, Maari, the picture of cool confidence, playfully challenges Anandhi with a cocky dance gesture.

story_beats.title: The Rebuttal
story_beats.description: Anandhi, unfazed, responds with an explosive and even more energetic dance move, catching Maari off-guard with her 'rowdy' spirit.

story_beats.title: Synchronized Chaos
story_beats.description: The one-upmanship transforms into a perfectly synchronized, high-octane dance duet. They move as one, a whirlwind of energy and color, their individual styles clashing and combining beautifully.

story_beats.title: The Final Pose
story_beats.description: As the energy peaks, they strike a final, iconic back-to-back pose, laughing triumphantly. They've proven they are an unstoppable, perfectly matched pair.

panels.caption: Hey en goli sodaave, en kari kozhambae!
Un kutty puppy naan, take me, take me!
Hey rowdy baby... unnale mood aachu!
One plus one two mama, you plus me free mama!
